about: Which games are on today's scoreboard, the only ones that can be monitored (#185). game_labels.on_todays_scoreboard on Windows and ScoreboardDay.isOnTodaysScoreboard on the iPhone are both held to it. 'date' is ESPN's UTC start; 'now' is the wall clock where the person is, in 'zone' (Python's naive now needs no zone; the iPhone builds the moment from it). Times stay clear of daylight saving changes, where wall-clock and elapsed hours differ. The Tokyo row is today's by this rule, but iPhone Live Scores doesn't list it yet (#222).
